title: Jason Duval: GTA 6's man who wants a simple life
subject: jason
description:
Would you trust Jason? 👇

Everything Rockstar has officially revealed about Jason Duval, GTA 6's co-protagonist: his past, the army, the Leonida Keys and Brian Heder. Based on Rockstar's official character bio.

scenes.text: Jason Duval just wants a simple life.
But he grew up surrounded by con artists and criminals, and joined the army partly to escape all of it.
Now he's back in the Leonida Keys, smuggling for a local dealer named Brian Heder.
Brian lets him live rent-free, as long as Jason handles the intimidation work.
Rockstar sums him up in one line: it just keeps getting harder for him, even though
